2607.18163.title: OR Else: A Differentiable Trust Region for Policy Optimization
2607.18163.paper_summary: PPO and the GRPO baseline studied here use clipped surrogate objectives whose favorable-direction saturation introduces an abrupt change in the scalar objective's derivative. We ask whether Output Reset (OR), a smooth one-sided saturation rule, offers a useful alternative for large language model post-training. PPO-OR and GRPO-OR replace the clipped policy term with an OR squared-margin loss in rollout-relative token log-ratio space; the advantage sign determines the update direction, and a token contributes zero direct OR residual after crossing the favorable margin. We compare PPO-clip with PPO-OR under generalized advantage estimation (GAE), and GRPO with GRPO-OR under group-relative advantages, using \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} on Anthropic \texttt{hh-rlhf} with one shared reward model and three seeds per method. Under GAE, PPO-OR has a mean final training-time reward-model score $0.305$ higher than PPO-clip, with a larger observed across-seed spread. Under group-relative advantages, GRPO-OR does not have a higher mean score, but shows a smaller observed spread, a near-zero terminal OR residual, and a declining overshoot fraction, while the matched GRPO clipped-objective trace remains variable. Both group-relative methods exhibit substantially larger rollout-to-current log-ratio displacement than the GAE methods, and OR does not consistently reduce it. Thus, OR changes optimization behavior in both matched comparisons, but the observed reward effect differs between them. At $G=2$, the GRPO-OR diagnostics do not translate into a reward-score gain. Whether larger groups change this outcome remains open. The reported scores are training-time reward-model measurements, not held-out human-preference performance.
2607.18163.paper_summary_zh: PPO 和此處研究的 GRPO 基線使用了剪裁的替代目標，其有利方向的飽和引入了標量目標導數的突然變化。我們詢問輸出重置（OR），這是一種平滑的單側飽和規則，是否為大型語言模型後訓練提供了一個有用的替代方案。PPO-OR 和 GRPO-OR 在回合相對的標記對數比空間中用 OR 平方邊際損失替換了剪裁的政策項；優勢符號決定更新方向，並且在越過有利邊際後，標記對直接的 OR 殘差貢獻為零。我們在使用 \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} 的 Anthropic \texttt{hh-rlhf} 上，將 PPO-clip 與 PPO-OR 在廣義優勢估計（GAE）下進行比較，並將 GRPO 與 GRPO-OR 在群體相對優勢下進行比較，每種方法使用一個共享的獎勵模型和三個隨機種子。在 GAE 下，PPO-OR 的平均最終訓練時間獎勵模型得分比 PPO-clip 高出 $0.305$，並且觀察到的跨種子變化更大。在群體相對優勢下，GRPO-OR 的平均得分並沒有更高，但顯示出較小的觀察變化、接近零的終端 OR 殘差和下降的超越比例，而匹配的 GRPO 剪裁目標痕跡仍然變化不定。這兩種群體相對方法在回合到當前的對數比位移上顯著大於 GAE 方法，而 OR 並未持續減少它。因此，OR 在這兩個匹配比較中改變了優化行為，但觀察到的獎勵效應在它們之間有所不同。在 $G=2$ 時，GRPO-OR 的診斷並未轉化為獎勵得分的增益。是否更大的群體會改變這一結果仍然是開放的。報告的得分是訓練時間獎勵模型的測量，而非保留的人類偏好表現。
